correctness.rationale: The coordinatewise lattice identity U:A_nu→R⊕_1 ell_1 has norm exactly max(s+t)/nu=K_nu, and inverse V has norm one. Projectivity of countable lattice ell_1 gives upper lifting constant K_nu. The explicit separable B=c⊕c_0 with pointwise max-over-n pair sum norm and finite-coordinate ideals has limit quotient isometric to R⊕_infty c_0; the target lattice homomorphism T(a,x)=(a,iota x) has norm one. For every stage m, any positive lattice-homomorphic lift must have coordinate-n first component approaching s for s e_0, while the second component for t e_n equals t for every n>m; positivity implies its image of (s,t e_n) has norm≥s+t in the n-th pair. Thus lifting norm≥(s+t)/nu(s,t) for every pair, giving K_nu, attained by explicit constant-a, iota-x lift. A stage-independent gap K_nu>1 obstructs semiprojectivity; K_nu=1 forces nu=s+t everywhere on positive quadrant. Finite exact specializations of ℓ_q and interpolating nu_theta agree numerically with formulas, but the arbitrary-norm classification is analytic.
